source_context.caption_hook: This is what your supply chain org chart looks like today.
caption_argument_segments: This is what your supply chain org chart looks like today. And this is what it will look like tomorrow. AI is not just changing tools. It’s redesigning roles.
Three big changes I see across companies:
The rise of the Supply Chain Orchestrator Someone who manages by exception, not by task Focusing on decisions, not data crunching
The emergence of App Makers / Super Analysts People from the business building their own tools Replacing hundreds of Excels with simple, scalable apps
The creation of AI Product roles To structure, prioritize, and govern all these initiatives Avoiding chaos at scale
The biggest shift is this: From execution To orchestration From manual work To decision-making
